block.gtceu.dimensional_finder.tooltip.1: §7This machine can send pulses into deep space, recording the echoes on crystals, and can sometimes triangulate a region's location based on that data.
block.gtceu.folding_akreyrium_stabiliser: §7A reintegration device designed to recombine Akreyrium. By folding the distinct variants of Akreyrium through a precise stabilization matrix over a crystal, a highly refined and pure version of Akreyrium can be obtained.
§7The folding stabiliser utilises a lens to focus the reintegration, The proper type should be chosen based on the Akreyrium variant, reinsertion is necessary after every use.
block.gtceu.gate_assembly.tooltip.0: §7A forge powerful enough to fuse together the parts of a stargate into one.
§7A machine that can fold together rods using large amounts of rotational force, condensing layers on top of layers to create some incredibly resilient materials.
block.gtceu.large_quantum_compressor.too: §7This multi can compress large amounts of matter into infusions and colapse gravi-stars into a singularities via said infusions.
block.gtceu.runic_circuitry_assembling_s: §7An apparatus crossing the boundaries between technology and magic, that can inscribe dense plates with pure singularities to write runes containing mystical powers.
block.gtceu.runic_inscribe_manipulate.to: §7A more advanced Runic Inscriber, that can layer runes on top of eachother to fuse their powers, or assemble them into a structured block form, so they can exert power over the material world.
§7A giant structure designed with the ability to create extremely strong blocks inscribed with ancient runes that hold the power to slip between the cracks in space.
block.gtceu.chemical_plant.tooltip.0: §7This machine can compress chemical lines into one recipe and is able to perform more advanced chemical reactions.
block.gtceu.component_part_assembly.tool: §7An assembler that can micro craft some incredibly complex components that are too detailed for a normal assembler.
block.gtceu.exotic_gas_siphon.tooltip.1: §7Utilising precision filtration and molecular isolation technologies, it efficiently separates exotic compounds from ambient environments, ensuring high-purity yields for any applications.
block.gtceu.exotic_gas_siphon.tooltip.4: §7Siphons exotic gasses directly from the atmosphere through a complex filtration and refining process, directly condensing traditional collection and distillation methods.
block.gtceu.exotic_gas_siphon.tooltip.7: §7This machine can collect the ambient air in the surrounding atmosphere, providing the same functionality as a basic §fGas Collector§7.
block.gtceu.heat_chamber.tooltip.0: §7This large multiblock can reach heats far beyond that of an EBF, and can use that heat to purify materials and catalyse reactions.
§7A machine that can provide incredible heat and pressure, making it capable of fusing together incomplete products into some of the most resilient materials known across the galaxy.
block.gtceu.nuclear_reactor.tooltip.0: §7A medium sized reactor that can use relatively simple nuclear reactions to make some extremely useful materials.
block.gtceu.primitive_ore_factory.toolti: §7Your first all in one ore processing machine.
block.gtceu.steam_ore_factory.tooltip.0: §7A slightly more advanced ore processor, that can accept inputs from busses and hatches, and because of that can be automated.
block.gtceu.electric_ore_factory.tooltip: §7The electric all in one ore processing machine.
block.gtceu.ore_processing_plant.tooltip: §7A new tier of ore processing machine that far exceeds the throughput capacity of the previous tier.
block.gtceu.bulk_ore_processing_array.to: §7The §4ULTIMATE§7 tier of ore processing machine that far exceeds the throughput capacity of all previous tiers.
§7§oIt's like having 256 Ore Processing Plants but better...
block.gtceu.industrial_barrel.tooltip.0: §7A BIG barrel that can do most of the things that both the Large Barrels can.
block.gtceu.large_barrel.tooltip.0: §7A larger and better barrel, that can process larger amounts of items faster than the small one, along with having some new recipes.
block.gtceu.large_farm.tooltip.0: §7An automated farm that runs during the day, providing you with some early sources of crops.
block.gtceu.large_stone_barrel.tooltip.0: §7A larger stone barrel that can make all kinds of stones and lava.
block.gtceu.rock_filtrator.tooltip.0: §7A multiblock that can sieve through gravel and sand more precisely than a basic sieve could ever achieve, uncovering the gems hidden inside.
block.gtceu.rock_filtrator.tooltip.2: §7You are gonna need multiple Output Busses
block.gtceu.rock_sifter.tooltip.0: §7A more powerful version of the Rock Filtrator, that can sieve materials at an astonishing speed.
block.gtceu.cobbleworks.tooltip.0: §7A large cube that can generate and process cobblestone into its most useful crushed forms, ready for sieving.

block.gtceu.mechanical_sieve.tooltip.0: §7A somewhat primitive machine that can sieve automatically for you, relying only on some power to pump out massive amounts of resources without any effort.
block.gtceu.void_excavator.tooltip.0: §7A more powerful Void Extractor that can harvest the resources from the abyss with unparalleled speed.

block.gtceu.void_extractor.tooltip.2: §7You are gonna need multiple Output Busses and Hatches
block.gtceu.essence_enchancer.tooltip.0: §7A convoluted machine, that can infuse mystical essences with large amounts of electricity to trigger a change in their composition, making them more useful.
block.gtceu.essence_replicator.tooltip.0: §7A machine that can duplicate essences indefinitely, although for the more advanced ones, it requires special fluids to function properly.
block.gtceu.dimensional_destabiliser.too: §7A mysterious structure that can stimulate cracks in space to harvest heavy elements from it that have never been observed before.
block.gtceu.greenhouse.tooltip.0: §7An electrical machine that stimulates the growth of plants, flowers and saplings, allowing you to more easily farm them.
block.gtceu.latex_plantation.tooltip.0: §7A multiblock that is way faster then the arboreal extractor for gathering latex
§7A powerful machine that can splice complex molten chemicals into smaller chunks for processing

block.gtceu.cyclonic_sifter.tooltip.0: §7An advanced tier of sifter that is more precise and stronger than the basic tier, allowing it to run better recipes.

quest.automation_age.plastic_circuit_boa: Better Circuits means better Circuit boards
quest.automation_age.maint_hatch_variant: &6Auto Maintenance Hatch&r: Ever worry about needing maintenance, well now you never have to.
&3Configurable Maintenance Hatch&r: Make your machines faster at the sake of risking more maintenance issues, or make them slower to reduce the chance.
Maintenance hatches will always check if they incure maintenance which can take a toll on your game's performance at scale. Auto Maintenance Fixes this concern.

Alternatively the Configurable Maintenance can range from .9x time to 1.1x time. Meaning you can either add/subtract 10% from a recipe time. Reducing long recipe times is very nice. Increasing Generator uptime is also very nice.
quest.automation_age.hv_assembler.desc: &6HV&r Assembler, used for &6HV&r Energy Hatches and Upgrade Kits, along with SMD's for cheaper circuit crafting.
quest.automation_age.lpic_chip.desc: This chip is used to make &6HV&r energy hatches and transformers.
quest.automation_age.lpic_chip.title: LPIC Chips
quest.automation_age.smd.desc: The first upgrade to every circuit component. Is more resource efficent and gives more per craft.
quest.automation_age.smd.title: SMD's
quest.automation_age.hv_upgrade_kit.desc: Will increase the power of anything thermal by 24x.
quest.automation_age.energy_crystal.desc: A crafting ingredient for items that need energy, and a battery that stores &6HV&r energy.
quest.automation_age.hv_autoclave.desc.2: Can be upgraded into a Large Autoclave soon.
quest.automation_age.nano_armor.desc: Armor with build in night vision and step assist.
quest.automation_age.nano_armor.title: NanoMuscle™ Suite
quest.automation_age.cleanroom.desc: The Cleanroom is a structure that filters inside itself, allowing for a dust free environment to achieve more precise crafting.
quest.automation_age.cleanroom.subtitle: A gamer's nightmare
quest.automation_age.hv_circuit_assemble: &5EV&r Circuits give you access to the &6HV&r Circuit Assembler. I recommend putting this in your Cleanroom to save time.
quest.automation_age.first_iv_circuit.de: The end of the circuit upgrade chain will bring you into &9IV&r, bet you didnt expect that.
quest.automation_age.iv_converter.desc.1: Allows you to turn RF into &5EV&r power.
quest.automation_age.iv_converter.desc.2: Oh ya and 64A converters exist from now on
quest.automation_age.ev_superconductor.d: &5EV&r superconductor, can hold 32 amps in a 1x cable.
quest.automation_age.nichrome_ingot.desc: Nichrome is one of the first alloys requiring a Vacuum Freezer to cool down.
3rd tier of coils for your EBF to allow you to increase the heat even more. Will start making hot ingots more often.
It also gives you your first heat based Overclocks for Aluminium and Stainless Steel notably.
quest.automation_age.ev_upgrade_kit.desc: Will increase the power of anything thermal by 48x. This is the final Upgrade Kit you can make for them.
quest.automation_age.ev_assembler.desc: You should understand what this does already right?
quest.automation_age.vacuum_freezer.desc: This cools down your Hot Ingots better and faster then the Chemical Bath could ever hope to achieve.
quest.automation_age.mb_upgrade_kir.desc: Used to turn &6HV&r machines into their &6Perfect Overclock&r multiblock variants
A very tall multiblock that allows you to distill one fluid into multiple others without having to choose like with the distillery.
Single block Distilleries can still be used but wont give you all products and can't be overclocked.
quest.automation_age.oil.desc: More Information in the Resource Production Tab
Allows you to pump oil from the void. I don't know how that works out, but it does.
Better Drills do not drain chunks as much and work much faster.
Allows you to scan your surrounding chunks for fluids.
Spoilers, its going to be oil.
quest.automation_age.desulfurizing.desc: Mix Oil distillation byproducts with some hydrogen to clean them, allowing you to distill them further.
quest.automation_age.cracking.desc.1: Choose an oil byproduct and get it cracked to allow even further processing.
quest.automation_age.cracking.desc.2: Taking some time to figure out which cracking method for what product is the best for you is recommended.
quest.automation_age.cracking.desc.3: Note: Chemical Reactors can be used for cracking but are less efficient.
quest.automation_age.cracking.subtitle: Cracked at cracking
quest.automation_age.cracking.title: Oil Cracking
quest.automation_age.byproduct_distillin: I hope you like having many distillation towers.
quest.automation_age.sb_rubber.desc.1: Another material that can be used to coat cables, is the most efficent resource wise.
quest.automation_age.sb_rubber.desc.2: Should now be easily craftable with oil distillation fully set up.
quest.automation_age.ev_energy_hatch.des: Allows you to run your multiblocks off of pure &5EV&r power, or even overclock to &9IV&r.
quest.automation_age.rtm_coils.desc.1: 4th tier of Coils for all your smelting needs.
quest.automation_age.rtm_coils.desc.2: This needs Ruthenium, which you get from the Platline, check it out in the "Processing Lines" chapter.
quest.automation_age.rtm_coils.subtitle: Almost as hot as an RTX
quest.automation_age.tungsten_steel_ingo: You are going to need a lot of this, just like every other main voltage material.
quest.automation_age.liquid_airs.desc: Distilling each air type will give you access to a variety of diffent chemicals, all of which will be useful in one way or another.
quest.automation_age.liquid_airs.title: Distilling Liquid Air
quest.automation_age.cupric_chlorid.desc: The best liquid for etching Circuit Boards.
We recommend switching out your &oAE2&r patterns to use this.
quest.automation_age.mpic.desc: This chip is used for making &5EV&r tier Energy Hatches and Transformers.
quest.automation_age.mpic.title: MPIC Chips
quest.automation_age.phosphorus_wafer.de: You can use this in a Laser Engraver to make new chips, or make the old ones more efficiently.
This hatch can do something called Speed Overclocking.
A Speed Overclock is a special kind of Overclocking, that makes your machine run recipes at the next tier of voltage.
However, unlike normal Overclock, it will not make the machine be able to do recipes at that higher tier.
As an example, a 4A &5EV&r Hatch will let a machine run at &9IV&r speed, but only do &5EV&r or lower recipes.
quest.automation_age.ev_energy_hatch_16a: A 16A &5EV&r Energy Hatch will let a machine run at &dLuV&r speed, but only do &5EV&r or lower recipes.
quest.automation_age.phosphorus_boule.de: Second tier of Boule. Can be used to make new types of chips as well as make older types more efficently.
quest.automation_age.phosphate.desc: Aquired from Apatite or Monazite processing.
quest.automation_age.soc.subtitle: Cheaper LV and MV Circuits
quest.automation_age.soc.title: SoC Chips
quest.automation_age.ender_air.desc.1: Can be done with some fancy mixing or Mystical Agriculture.
quest.automation_age.nether_air.desc.1: Can be done with some fancy mixing or Mystical Agriculture.
quest.automation_age.end_agglom.desc: The essence of the End, right in the palm of your hand.
quest.automation_age.nether_agllom.desc: The essence of the Nether, maybe it will bring some hot weather.
quest.automation_age.endstone.desc: Make some Endstone and get to processing it.
quest.automation_age.netherrack.desc: Make some Netherack and get to processing it.
quest.automation_age.lcr.desc: Now you have &8PTFE&r, you can make one of the most useful multiblocks, the Large Chemical Reactor (LCR for short). You will have so many of these by the end of the pack.
quest.automation_age.lcr.title: Large Chemical Reactor (LCR)
quest.automation_age.ev_circuit_assemble: Better Circuits, Fasters Circuits, Cheaper Circuits, this is a big one.
quest.automation_age.third_hv_circuit.de: The final &6HV&r circuit. Like previous circuits, this has a cheaper recipe once you gain access to a new chip.
quest.automation_age.epoxy_board.desc: The spoils from the massive expoy processing line.
quest.automation_age.nano_cpu.desc: A different way to make chips, by covering them in chemicals.
quest.automation_age.nano_cpu.title: Nano CPU Chips
quest.automation_age.nor_chip.desc: These chips will be needed in almost every other circuit from now on, might want to keep a lot of these in stock.
quest.automation_age.nor_chips.title: NOR Memory Chips
quest.automation_age.iv_energy_hatch.des: Lets you power your multiblocks with &9IV&r or overclock to &dLuv&r.
quest.automation_age.iv_assembler.desc: &9IV&r Assembly Machine, used to make higher tier Coils and Energy Hatches. Can be upgraded into the Assembly Machine multiblock's controller.
quest.automation_age.iv_converter.desc: Lets you turn your RF into &9IV&r power.
quest.automation_age.iv_superconductor.d: &9IV&r superconductor, can hold 64 amps in a 1x cable.
quest.automation_age.hpic.desc: This Chip is used in both &9IV&r and &dLuV&r Energy Hatches and Transformers as well as Assembly Line Casings.
quest.automation_age.hpic.title: HPIC Chips
quest.automation_age.advanced_smd.desc: The second upgrade to all the Circuit Components. Very resource efficient and is needed for high tier Circuits.
quest.automation_age.advanced_smd.title: Advanced SMD's
quest.automation_age.hssg_coil.desc.2: These will give you the heat to make HSS-E and HSS-S ingots. Thats not going to get confusing at all.
quest.automation_age.hssg_ingot.desc: The first High Speed Steel available.
quest.automation_age.hsss_ingot.desc: A denser and harder form of HSS.
quest.automation_age.abs.desc.1: This multiblock allows you to create even more complex alloys, but will give outputs in a molten form.
quest.automation_age.abs.desc.2: The ABS does both the mixing and smelting, and gives multiple units of ingots (144mb) as output because of this while only taking 75% the time of their EBF counter-part.
quest.automation_age.abs.desc.3: You will need to cool the Molten Liquids in a Vacuum Freezer..
quest.automation_age.nuclear_reactor.des: The Nuclear Reactor can be used to transform &8Thorium&r into &aUranium&r and &2Uraniums&r into &cPlutoniums&r. Additionally it produces quite a lot of power.
Make sure that your dynamo hatches are big enough.
Oh, and maybe look into paralleling this thing when you can, you could say it causes quite the reaction.
quest.automation_age.radon.desc.1: A gas that will be used a lot for Quantum Eyes and Stars.
quest.automation_age.radon.desc.2: We highly recommend setting Radon Loop up when you can, even if you have Ender Air distillation.
quest.automation_age.nand_chip.subtitle: Used for data storage
quest.automation_age.nand_chip.title: NAND Memory Chips
quest.automation_age.lockable_hatches.de: Go Read About Lockable Fluid Hatches
quest.automation_age.power_link.desc.1: More power storage options and batteries are shown.
quest.automation_age.laminated_glass.des: A type of reinforced Glass, with better sealing capacities.
quest.automation_age.industrial_barrel.d: A &oBIG&r barrel that can scale with your power allowing you to barrel even harder.
quest.automation_age.heavy_oil_alt.desc: Heavy Oil can alternatively be made in a Pyrolysed Oven
quest.automation_age.title: Automation Age
